name: backend-dotnet-senior
jobPosting:
Senior Backend Engineer (.NET)

Acme Payments is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team.

What you will do:
- Design and build APIs for our payment services.
- Mentor other engineers.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional experience with C# and .NET.
- Solid experience with PostgreSQL.
- Experience building REST APIs.
- Experience with Docker.
- Fluent English.

Nice to have:
- Kubernetes.
- Terraform.

We offer remote work and a learning budget.

Data Scientist - Mid level

We are a retail analytics startup. You will build forecasting models and work with product teams.

You must have:
- A degree in Computer Science, Statistics or a related field.
- 3 years of experience with Python.
- Strong SQL skills.
- Experience with scikit-learn or similar machine learning libraries.

Bonus points for:
- Experience with Spark.
- AWS certification.
